title: 18. Areas Where Panchayati Raj Does NOT Apply

blocks.content: The act does not apply to the states of Nagaland, Meghalaya and Mizoram and certain other specified areas.

items: Remember the three fully exempted states: Nagaland, Meghalaya, and Mizoram.
PESA Act 1996 extends Part IX provisions to Scheduled Areas in 10 states with custom protections.
Darjeeling Gorkha Hill Council exists in place of a Zilla Parishad in Darjeeling district.

blocks.title: Key Takeaways
items: The 73rd Constitutional Amendment Act does not apply to the states of Nagaland, Meghalaya, and Mizoram.
Fifth Schedule Areas and Sixth Schedule Tribal Areas are excluded from general Part IX provisions.
The hill areas of Manipur with existing district councils and the Darjeeling hill area in West Bengal are specifically exempted.
Parliament enacted the PESA Act in 1996 to extend modified Panchayati Raj provisions to Fifth Schedule Areas.
The National Capital Territory of Delhi is excluded from the purview of Part IX of the Constitution.
